films.name: How a sailfish actually hunts
films.lesson: Show insertion, contact and capture as separate events. Keep the bill rigid and prey at the mouth.
films.limitation: Instructional close-ups still need anatomical review.
films.speech_audit_note: ASR: it/its substitution at the end.

films.name: The story behind the $2.2M pair
films.lesson: Get to Jordan and the human gift early. Keep both shoes and the factual price consistent.
films.speech_audit_note: ASR: spelling/number variants; final dollars not transcribed. Currency is explicit on screen.

films.name: What six characters really mean
films.lesson: Let the viewer read the clue. Explain the measurement and distinguish it from speculation.
films.limitation: An unresolved source limits the dramatic payoff.

films.name: The last bus
films.lesson: Preserve the bus layout, character identity and real escape routes. Let each threat change the situation.
films.limitation: The middle still relies on repeated bus and phone views.
